exam_scheme.note: The Common Admission Test (CAT) is conducted by the Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) for admission into various undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, prominently its Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) courses across the School of Engineering (Thrikkakara Campus) and CUCEK (Kuttanad Campus). The B.Tech entrance examination (Test Code: 101) is a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 3 hours (180 minutes) duration comprising 225 multiple-choice questions: Mathematics (90 questions), Physics (75 questions), and Chemistry (60 questions). Marking scheme: 3 marks are awarded for each correct answer and 1 mark is deducted for each incorrect answer (total 675 marks).
